Card Q&A.q: Can this card's [When Attacking] effect delete this Digimon even when my opponent has no Digimon?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. You can't hatch a new Digi-Egg when you have another Digimon in your breeding area.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [On Deletion] effect to hatch in my breeding area when I have a Digimon in my breeding area and a Tamer?
Can I use this card's [On Deletion] effect to place this card in my security stack when I have a Digimon in my breeding area and a Tamer, even if I can't hatch in my breeding area?

Card Q&A.a: No, you don't have to place it. If there are requirements for the target card and that card is in a private area, performing the action is optional.
Card Q&A.q: If I have a yellow card with the [Vaccine] trait in my hand when this card's inherited effect activates, do I have to place it at the bottom of my security stack?

Effect: [When Attacking] By deleting this Digimon, activate 1 of the effects below:
・Place 1 of your opponent's Digimon with the [Virus] trait at the bottom of their security stack.
・1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -5000 DP for the turn.
[On Deletion] Place this card at the bottom of your security stack. Then, if you have a Tamer, you may hatch in your breeding area.
Inherited Effect: [On Deletion] Place 1 yellow card with the [Vaccine] trait from your hand at the bottom of your security stack.
